game_moneyline_spread.label: Game moneyline and spread
game_moneyline_spread.target: Probability a team wins (regulation plus overtime; no ties) or covers a spread rung.

game_stat_props.label: Game and team stat props
game_stat_props.target: Probability that a team or game statistic (yards, turnovers, sacks, TDs, first downs, etc.) meets a threshold per official stat source.

game_total.label: Game total points
game_total.target: Probability that total points exceed a rung (regulation plus overtime per wording).

overtime.label: Overtime occurrence and overtime length
overtime.target: Probability that the game goes to overtime (and potentially to multiple overtimes) as defined in the contract.

quarter_and_half_sides.label: Quarter and half moneyline and spread
quarter_and_half_sides.target: Probability a team leads/wins or covers a spread in a specific half or quarter (period margin, ties per wording).

quarter_and_half_totals.label: Quarter and half totals and team totals
quarter_and_half_totals.target: Probability that points in a quarter/half (game or one team) exceed a rung.

season_futures.label: Season-level events (conference, playoff, title, awards)
season_futures.target: Probability of a season-level college event (conference title, playoff berth/seed, national title, final ranking, award).

team_total.label: Team total points
team_total.target: Probability that one team's points exceed a rung.

touchdown_scorer.label: Touchdown scorer markets (anytime and first)
touchdown_scorer.target: Probability that a named player scores a touchdown (anytime or first) under contract definition.

unreg:awards_and_honors.label: College football awards (Heisman and conference awards)
unreg:awards_and_honors.target: Winner of a voted individual award.

unreg:coaching_and_governance_events.label: College football coaching, transfer and conference-governance events
unreg:coaching_and_governance_events.target: Whether a named personnel, transfer or governance event happens by a stated date, or which person fills a role.

unreg:polls_and_cfp_rankings.label: College football AP poll and CFP ranking markets
unreg:polls_and_cfp_rankings.target: A team's rank (or being in the top N, or the number of distinct #1 teams) in the AP poll or CFP rankings on a stated date.

unreg:team_event_counting_specials.label: College football team and event counting specials
unreg:team_event_counting_specials.target: A team or game count (turnovers gained, sacks, interceptions, field goals, two-point conversions) or a rare event (weather delay) relative to a threshold.
